transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As we all know, we're reviewing the student oral-history project for the spring term, which will culminate in a public school exhibit. The current draft on the table proposes participation by grades 7 and 8, one supervising adult per session, cloud-based audio storage, a 90-day retention period, and a public exhibit of selected recordings. Before I can sign off on this plan, I want to hear from each of you -- the classroom teacher, privacy officer, librarian, and family liaison -- on any concerns or suggestions you have. Let's work through the design and implementation details together. Who would like to start?
